Name: Run ADK Triage Agent
Author: 0816a58d-23e4-4e8b-b33f-996ee7ecfc63
Description: Executes an automated Tier 1 alert triage agent pipeline powered by Google ADK. Performs multi-stage security case analysis, context retrieval, evidence gathering, and publishes reasoning, verdict, and recommended remediation actions to the Case Wall.

Parameters.Description: If true, runs triage analysis without posting status changes or comments to the case.
The triage analyst identity or tag to associate with this triage run.
Whether to equip the agent with persistent long-term memory via Vertex AI Memory Bank.
Optional session identifier to scope memory context. Defaults to active case ID (case_<CaseId>).
